en.name: Skipper
en.ability: Each night*, you learn if the Demon is closer to the left or the right of today's executed player. If an evil player is executed, you are drunk until dawn.

en.otherNightReminder: Tell the Skipper left or right.

zh.name: 船长
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你会得知恶魔更接近当天被处决玩家的左侧还是右侧。如果邪恶玩家被处决，你醉酒直到下个黎明。
